title: Safeguard sprint sync playbook: cross-program milestone alignment and rotational evidence owners
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Playbook to synchronize compliance/security milestones (SOC2/ISO, SSO/SAML, audit logs) across PM, Eng, Design and Security teams with a lightweight, repeatable cadence. Goal: reduce evidence collection friction, prevent gating surprises during Dedicated/Private rollouts, and establish rotational owners for each milestone and artifact bucket.
milestones: M1: Kickoff & scope alignment (owners assigned, artifact map) - target 2026-02-17
M2: Evidence ingestion pipelines prototyped (S3 -> evidence-store + Confluence auto-link) - target 2026-03-03
M3: Release gate checklist defined & mapped to cycle rails (canary, dedicated reserve, private upgrade) - target 2026-03-17
M4: Dry-run audit & internal attestation (cross-team tabletop) - target 2026-03-24
M5: Final signoff + artifacts archived for SOC2/ISO milestone - target 2026-03-31
acceptance_criteria: Artifact map completed and published to Confluence with ownership and retention policy links
At least two evidence ingestion flows automated (audit logs and SSO assertion logs) into evidence-store with searchable metadata
Release gate checklist enforced in pipeline: failing gate blocks Dedicated/Private deploys until remediation ticket created
Rotational owners roster published and added to on-call pager schedule for the milestone window
Post-dry-run action log created and prioritized in Linear with owners and estimates
updates: 2026-02-11: Kickoff held with Eng, Security, and Design. Agreed artifact taxonomy: identity, network, runtime, telemetry, policy docs.
2026-02-18: Security prototyped S3 ingestion lambda that enriches audit log events with tenant metadata. Proof-of-concept landed: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1294
2026-02-25: PM group ratified 3-week runway buffer per milestone to absorb infra churn. Added to playbook.
2026-03-03: UX handed off audit evidence UX spec for Console evidence viewer. Design feedback iteration started.
2026-03-09: Discovered gap: private on-prem upgrade process produces non-standard audit artifacts. Created ENG-37910 to normalize collector output. Blocker until 2026-03-15.
2026-03-12: Dry-run tabletop scheduled for 2026-03-22. Ops to simulate tenant restore and produce SSO assertion logs for ingestion test.
next_steps: Confirm rotational owners roster and add to schedule by 2026-03-14
Complete two ingestion flows (audit logs + SSO assertions) and validate query latency < 2s for evidence queries
Finalize release gate checklist and add gating job to CI/CD (ops + infra pairing)
Run tabletop and capture remediation items, post results to Confluence
notes: This ticket is intentionally playbook-focused rather than implementing all ingestion work. Implementation will be split into ENG sub-issues once acceptance criteria are firm. Coordinate with Compliance Ops (owner: Maya Chen) and Privacy (owner: Tomás Rivera). Keep artifacts minimally duplicated by using Confluence canonical links and evidence-store IDs.
